title: Shilshole S (shore effects)
assumptions: Wind from 215 deg (SW by S); Mike: SSW to SW is needed for waves to reach the marina; a due-S sea gives almost nothing there (docs/sea-states/wave-transfer-prototype.md). At 4 s the marina entrance buoy gets about 0.4 of open-water height from this direction.
Waves toward 35 deg +-20 deg, periods 2.6, 3.3 and 4.1 s (around about 12 km of fetch across the Sound at 20 kt, a guess).
Same breakwall and shore reflection as the N preset. No tide, current, regrowth.
